description: Controls when RedCap may move from catalog + rg + metadata to FTS, RAG, or GraphRAG. This policy prevents early heavy retrieval adoption while keeping a machine-visible trigger for future scale.

routes.meaning: Use docs catalog, knowledge index, shared-knowledge metadata, file lookup dictionary, and rg before reading exact evidence bodies.
Add a local full-text index when metadata and rg remain useful but document count makes repeated exact scans noisy.
Add chunking, embeddings, reranking, and evidence-path citation only after semantic retrieval misses become a measured bottleneck.
Add entity extraction, relationship graph, and community summaries only after relationship-heavy questions repeatedly fail file and metadata retrieval.

current_observations.review_basis: RedCap now has a knowledge gateway route, split lessons modules, cold archive inventory, reviewed-substantive redcap-arsenal samples, and unchanged zero retrieval-miss observations; index-rg-metadata remains sufficient.

evidence_sources: task reports that record failed or noisy retrieval during real work
Prism reviews that identify semantic lookup or relationship tracing misses
shared-knowledge import batches that materially increase user-authored entries
required_update_points: before closing a task that observed retrieval misses
before closing a shared-knowledge import or migration task
before opening any FTS/RAG/GraphRAG escalation task
observation_update_rule.note: Automatic scale metrics are computed by the checker; observation metrics are deliberately evidence-based and must be updated only from recorded misses, not guesses.

next_action_when_threshold_crossed: Open a new RedCap task to evaluate FTS/RAG/GraphRAG with Prism review, source-path-preserving evidence, privacy review, and an explicit rollback plan before enabling any heavy retrieval runtime.
